set.use: Strep pharyngitis with 4 Centor points (no test needed); first-line bacterial sinusitis and healthy-outpatient CAP; actinomycosis; 7 days for bacteriuria in pregnancy; with gentamicin for a neonatal UTI

set.mechanism: Strongest beta-lactams; Enterobacterales resist them via efflux pumps, lower outer-membrane permeability and, above all, KPC, NDM and VIM carbapenemases that clavulanate barely blocks
Nitroimidazole that generates nitrogen free radicals; the newer nitroimidazole for drug-resistant TB was built on the same chemistry
Binds ergosterol, the sterol fungal membranes use in place of cholesterol, disrupting the membrane; Candida lusitaniae and C. guilliermondii resist it
set.use: Severe or disseminated endemic mycoses, including talaromycosis; with flucytosine for cryptococcal meningitis; with surgical debridement for mucormycosis; disseminated candidiasis

set.mechanism: Azole whose heavy use has selected resistant Candida: C. glabrata often has reduced susceptibility or intrinsic resistance, and C. krusei resists the azoles
